contract: custom_metadata_provider_added is emitted by POST /api/custom-metadata-providers after the row is created, through SocketAuthority.emitter, to every authenticated socket (admin and normal users alike, every connection) and to no unauthenticated socket. Its single argument is the provider's toClientJson: {id, name, mediaType, slug: custom-<id>}. Each successful create emits one event in request order; a create rejected with 400 or 403 emits none.
exceptions: force is not applicable: the event has no force/override variant; it is emitted once per successful create.

invariants.contract: A successful create emits exactly one custom_metadata_provider_added to every authenticated socket (admin, listener and finisher) and none to an unauthenticated socket, with the payload {id, name, mediaType, slug custom-<id>} of the created provider. Two sockets of one user each get one. Two creates emit two events in request order, and an add after a removal still emits exactly one for the new provider. A create rejected with 400 Invalid url or 403 emits no event to any socket and adds no row.
